parsed.title: GOD AS ROOT - Long Edition
parsed.summary: Long-form source edition arguing the Trinitarian God is the single ground axiom (Layer 0) from which existence, distinction, relation, and orientation derive; physics is the created medium/grammar for love and redemption, not God or grace. Ten physical laws read together compose a portrait of Christ with agency as the repeated structural gap. Includes the Necessary Ground argument, the 24-step Descent, Cross-Resolution method, progressive revelation, and named kill conditions.
